about: Reviewed ingredient vocabulary maintained by this project. It records identities and cooking roles only: no nutrient or flavor values. 'usda' is an exact SR Legacy description and 'flavordb' an exact FlavorDB2 entity name; the build fails loudly if either does not exist. 'proxy' marks a stand-in record.
